summary:
Implementation plan for the Flood Damage Space Mapper disaster response web application.
Includes:
- Architecture diagram and folder structure for frontend, backend-node, and backend-python
- Full-screen interactive Leaflet map dashboard with CARTO Dark Matter, Humanitarian OSM, and multispectral/radar layers
- Pre/Post satellite imagery toggle, flood/debris segmentation mask, OSM road network, and cut-off settlements layer
- Express.js API gateway (/api/fetch-satellite, /api/fetch-osm, /api/analyze, /api/report, /api/history)
- Python ML microservice (PyTorch Kuro Siwo segmentation pipeline, NetworkX road network connectivity analysis, Gemini bilingual English/Nepali situation report generator)
- Emergency response dark HUD theme conforming to science/disaster console design rules
